claims.claim: Uncertainty-aware Blur Prior (UBP) 估计配对数据中的不确定性。
claims.quote:
Algorithm 1 Uncertainty-aware Blur Prior Framework
1: Input: Multimodal training dataset $P_{M}$ 2: Model: Brain encoder $f_{B}$ with random parameters $\theta$ , pretrained vision encoder $f_{V}$ with parameters $\phi$ , temperature parameter $\tau$ , learning rate $\eta$ 3: Output: Trained model $f_{B}$ 4: for each iteration do
5: Obtain training sample ( $x_{v}, x_{b}$ ) from dataset $P_{M}$ 6: Obtain $\tilde{x}_{v}$ by Eq. (4) with blur radius r
7: $h_{b} = f_{B}(x_{b})$ ; $h_{v} = f_{V}(\tilde{x}_{v})$ 8: Compute loss L by Eq. (1)
9: Update r for sample ( $x_{v}, x_{b}$ ) by Eq. (10)
10: Update model parameters $\theta \leftarrow \theta - \eta \nabla L$ 11: end for
12: return trained model $f_{B}$

claims.claim: 原始 Brain2Image (2017) 的论文标题是 "Brain2Image: Converting Brain Signals into Images"。
claims.quote: Our Brain2Image approach consists of an encoder, which aims at identifying a latent feature space for brain signal classification, and a decoder, which turns the learned feature into images using a deconvolution approach. In our case, the encoder consists of an LSTM layer
claims.exposed_quote: Our Brain2Image approach was trained and tested using EEG data from six subjects while they were looking at images from 40 ImageNet classes. As generative models, we compared variational autoencoders (VAE) and generative adversarial net works (GAN). The results show that, indeed, our approach is able to generate an image drawn from the same distribution of the shown images. Furthermore, GAN, despite generating less realistic images, show better performance than VAE, especially as concern sharpness. The obtained performance provides useful hints on the fact that EEG contains patterns related to visual content and that such patterns can be used to efectively generate images that are semantically coherent to the evoking visual stimuli.
